findings.title: Page implies Product content but has no Product structured data
findings.evidence: Content-based signal detected for Product (e.g. price pattern or FAQ-shaped headings) but @type=Product absent from JSON-LD on https://linear.app. Types actually present: none.

suggested_action.summary: Add Product JSON-LD matching what the page already says in prose.
suggested_action.mechanism: Structured data is what an assistant quotes from directly; prose alone requires the extractor to correctly parse free text, which is far less reliable.
